name: Abraham Perez
introText: I'm a software engineer specializing in React and React Native. Right now I'm at Self Financial, building the web and mobile experiences that help people build credit and savings.
aboutMeText: Hello! I'm Abraham, and I enjoy creating things that live on the internet and in people's pockets. My interest in software started back in 2018, in an Internet Programming class where I first played with HTML, CSS, and jQuery. I was hooked the moment I realized I could build any interface with just a computer.

Fast-forward to today: I've interned twice at ExxonMobil, spent five years at Walmart leading frontend work on the international Warehouse Management System, and I now work at Self Financial, shipping features across their React Native app and Next.js web app.
These days I care most about clean UI, fast experimentation, and developer experience, including the AI-assisted tooling that helps my team ship faster.
Here are a few technologies I've been working with recently:

experience.title: Software Engineer
responsabilities: Build member-facing features across Self's React Native app and Next.js web app from a shared TypeScript monorepo
Ship A/B experiments on credit-building funnels, from Figma handoff to feature-flagged rollout and analytics tracking
Contribute components, icons, and Figma Code Connect mappings to the v4 design system
Hardened native Plaid bank linking for app-to-app OAuth hand-offs
Build AI-assisted developer tooling (Claude Code agent skills) for demos, simulator runs, and QA; serve as a frontend code owner

experience.title: Full Stack Engineer
responsabilities: Led a team of 4 frontend engineers in supporting the international Warehouse Management System (WMS)
Oversaw developers in a multi-flavor micro-services system, ensuring high code quality and adherence to configuration management for reliable app releases
Leveraged React & Android Native expertise to train teammates, boosting code delivery speed by 30%
Reduced tech-debt by 25% through proactive refactoring and upgrading dependencies and CI/CDs
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in designing and grooming user stories

experience.title: Full Stack Intern
responsabilities: Developed a serverless application on Azure for refineries. This application launched into 8 refineries globally
Automated infrastructure of React.js app with Terraform
Efficiently worked as a Scrum team using Azure DevOps for versioning control, project management, and CI/CD
Hardened app by migrating current authentication to a role-based authentication
Lowered replication cost by redesigning the entire database using Azure Table Storage

experience.title: Admin Analyst
responsabilities: Combined previous data visualizations into one automated and manageable web dashboard with Flask
Automated software delivery process by setting up CI/CD pipeline in OpenShift Container Platform
Worked in an Agile development cycle using Scrum methodologies
